authority: Author source inspection and source-byte comparison with the last full build; not a compiler/test/native-runtime result.
production_dependency: require_loader_attach_runtime: one owning Runtime/Domain root exists before publication and all application startup effects.
implementation: Controller consumes actual Runtime plus its certified Ready Domain before publication. New start_application requires the exact original controller/fiber, a nonnull module and a Constructed Runtime.

The owner publishes Runtime and invokes its real ApplicationEntry(module,DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH,reserved) synchronously once. No worker/milestone wait, extra initialization thread, fake Runtime or deferred startup is added.

Publication/startup/success phases live in the existing lock-free lifecycle record. Normal lower LastError is retained. Reentrant lifecycle use poisons the owner; precondition rejection leaves unpublished roots available for cooperative retirement.

After publication, exception or FALSE application return is sticky Poisoned with both roots retained. It throws to the owning source caller; it is not rollback and cannot be translated into safe DllMain FALSE. Existing noexcept native gateway may terminate before a source catch.

Actual Resources integration scenario now transfers roots before starting its three Domain workers and keeps that same owner through Runtime retirement/Domain lease retry. The raw Runtime pointer is an observer and is cleared before owner retirement.

Required production attach hook now returns BOOL for the entire owned synchronous startup. DllMain forwards that result and no longer obtains a Runtime pointer or independently invokes ApplicationEntry outside the hook. This is a HOST source contract change, not a definition of the required hook.
test_source_scenarios_not_run: Null image and wrong-thread rejection before Runtime publication; never-published complete retirement.
Existing concrete Resources/three-native-worker/host/IOCP scenario uses owned synchronous startup, rejects second startup and retires via the same owner.
still_open: Both required production loader hooks remain undefined.
Runtime/Domain/Controller outside-loader-lock contract is unchanged; this method is not yet a supported DllMain implementation.
Concrete per-image production assembly, automatic valid startup activation, image/foreign/CRT lifetime, failed attach and process termination policies remain open.
